name: Topbar Dashboard
description:
A dashboard that slides out of the top bar, joined to it with curved corners. Includes weather, system info, a calendar with your GNOME events, CPU/RAM/disk usage and processor power draw, a media player (MPRIS) and a workspace switcher.

Inspired by the Caelestia shell. Automatically switches to a glass look when Blur my Shell blurs the top bar.

Weather data comes from Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com). Your coordinates are sent to it only after you pick a city in the preferences. Showing processor power requires read access to /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/energy_uj (see the project page).
